system.description: You can spend a Force Point as a Swift Action to surround yourself with whirling winds. You gain Concealment from all other targets and gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Reflex Defense against Thrown Weapons. This effect lasts until the end of the encounter.

prerequisite.text: a member of The Shapers of Kro Var
